Discover the hero inside us all when Disney On Ice returns to Brooklyn for 8 shows on January 18 – 21.

Step inside the story of Encanto with Mirabel and her family and learn that everyone has a special gift. Sail away with Moana and Maui on their journey across the ocean. Join Elsa on her quest to protect Arendelle. Be inspired as you swim under the sea with Ariel, explore with Belle, and sing-along with Rapunzel. Experience world-class ice skating, iconic music, and stunning costumes that will make Disney On Ice: Find Your Hero an experience the whole family will treasure forever.
